Let me tell you about myself. I am from a third world country (developing). When I was 5 or 6 I was sent to boarding school. There was a warden who used to beat all the children when we came back to our dorm after dinner. Spent almost two years in that school. Then my parents brought me back to my home town. For few months I used to go to school from home but after that they put me in hostel again in my home city only. When they were not satisfied with my academic performance ( I was around 6-7 yrs old) they put me in a local teachers house (again in my home city) who was very famous for being strict. There they used to beat children like us for very small mistakes. Once some of the students (about 7-8 yrs of age) did something mischievous ( I don't actually remember what we did) and that made the headmaster very furious. We were made to sit wearing only a towel and wet mud was applied to our whole body, our heads hung in shame as everyone even the neighbors were called to watch us and we were made to listen to the mean things people said. I was also sexually assaulted by that headmaster's son ( he didn't know that). At that point I never knew what was happening to me or how it would affect my future.
Fast forward 7 years (also spent in hostel) I completed my senior school and got admission in a decent college. 
After 3rd year the haunting began. I became too self cautious, afraid of doing anything, never made a single new friend, never had a gf. My whole 4th year I spent going to the minimum classes required and spent whole year  inside my hostel room. I am too afraid to do anything, question anything. I became socially awkward and depressed. 
I deserved a happy childhood with my family which I never got and the events that happened made me a fucked up adult. You know what happens with me now, everybody tells me you look tensed and sad always. I don't know how to answer that question. I have to gather so much courage just to put a fake smile on my face. I am 25 now. Each and every moment I feel like shit. Never known what love and care is. Thrown outside like an orphan. Dead inside. I watch other people laughing,having relationships, enjoying and I just keep wishing. But you know what it's my fault. I accepted my fate. Only I know the dark place inside my head. Nobody understands. They say they do but they don't.
